components.name: Feed Client
components.purpose: Publishes posts and requests cursor-based feed pages.

components.name: API Gateway
components.purpose: Authenticates post, follow and feed operations.

components.name: Post Service
components.purpose: Owns durable posts, author timelines and publication events.

components.name: Post Database
components.purpose: Stores authoritative posts and replayable publication outbox records.

components.name: Social Graph Service
components.purpose: Owns follows, blocks and privacy versions.

components.name: Relationship Database
components.purpose: Indexes follower and following access paths and eligibility changes.

components.name: Fanout Workers
components.purpose: Write idempotent bounded recipient feed references for eligible authors.

components.name: Home Feed Store
components.purpose: Stores derived recipient references, not the only copy of posts or permissions.

components.name: Feed Service
components.purpose: Merges candidate sources, filters eligibility and hydrates results.

components.name: High-degree Author Streams
components.purpose: Provides pull-based candidate posts for high-degree authors.

components.name: Ranking Service
components.purpose: Optional bounded-latency scoring; chronological fallback remains available.

tradeoffs.guidance: Estimate amplification and read latency for the stated follower distribution.
Describe duplicates, edits and newly inserted posts explicitly.

alternatives: Versioned invalidation with a bounded staleness contract
tradeoffs.guidance: Do not serve blocked/private content merely because a feed reference exists.

dataModel.notes: Index the author stream and preserve deletion markers long enough for replay.
Support reverse enumeration and explicit race semantics.
Bound feed length; insertion is idempotent and rebuildable.
Durably link accepted publication to replayable fanout work.
Bind to the recipient and ordering semantics; do not trust arbitrary client offsets.
Authoritative eligibility filtering applies even to previously cached feed entries.
Evaluate current private-account eligibility and define revocation behavior.

flows.name: Publish fanout
steps: Commit a post and recoverable publication event
Classify author workload under the chosen fanout policy
Partition ordinary-author recipient work and insert references idempotently
Keep high-degree author posts available for pull-based merge

flows.name: Read
steps: Read a bounded recipient reference window plus high-degree author candidates
Merge using stable ordering and cursor semantics
Filter current visibility, blocks and deletions
Hydrate eligible post metadata and return at most 20 references with a next cursor
